title: Fed's rate hike push may be a mistake. Here's why
content: Experts argue that the Fed is looking at the wrong data as it pushes for more interest-rate hikes, with falling gasoline and energy prices suggesting inflation pressures are already easing.

title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
content: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

title: Bitcoin miner that sold its last BTC warns it may run short of cash for $1.2 billion AI deal
content: Hyperscale Data needs another $74.8 million to complete its Michigan data center project, even after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.

title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
content: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut. This follows a $500 million pre-IPO rush that comes with notable fine print.

title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
content: Despite a Commodity Futures Trading Commission demand that prediction markets return to operating in all 50 states, federal courts continue to get in the way.

title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
content: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.

title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
content: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.

title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
content: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.

title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
content: The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.

title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
content: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
content: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
content: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
content: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.

title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
content: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.
